implemented_contracts: editorial hierarchy, restrained color, thin strokes and semantic focus
light and dark surface roles with readable text and essential marks
explicit semantic node and message roles rather than label-based guessing
visible ALT branch guards and explicit return messages
density budgets, legends, destination sizing and local publication checks
intentional_differences: three diagram families rather than all upstream types
deterministic local layout rather than unconstrained visual composition
contrast-adjusted accent and conservative font metrics
simple sequence frames with at most one nested level
no animation, website scraping, GUI or broad imports
update_process: Compare upstream semantic changes against these contracts; add a source fixture and geometry or browser regression before changing rendering. Version bumps alone do not require feature work.
